THE MUTATION IS NOW IN THE NETWORK. Each node sits at its side-chain centroid, each edge
is weighted by the volumes it joins, and a substitution changes every edge touching its
site -- so dG = -G dK G is a response to the mutation and not a description of the fold.
S1 measures that directly. dg_self, dg_total and dg_far vary across substitutions at
98.9% of multiply-substituted residues, where the reviewed draft would have scored ZERO --
the perturbation is real. S1 FAILED on dg_reach alone, which varies at only 1.1%:
a threshold COUNT is too coarse to move when one side-chain volume changes, so it is a
wild-type descriptor after all. The gate caught one of four, which is what it is for.
Surviving features vary at 1.1%+ and carry R2 of only 0.10-0.25 against loop 54's
fifteen distinct columns -- so they are GENUINELY NEW INFORMATION, and they do not help.
